title: 0043 수주 완료 보고 — 서버만 쓴다(추가만, 고치기 · 지우기 없음), 그 팩토리 구성원만 읽는다, 종류 둘 · 사진 10장까지 · 같은 팩토리 수주만, 비공개 사진 버킷 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0043_order_reports.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'expert', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, {{y_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_x}})
INSERT INTO public.design_snapshots (id, design_id, rev, content_hash, design_payload, bom_payload, item_count) VALUES ({{snap_x}}, {{design_x}}, 1, 'probe', '{}', '{}', 1)

INSERT INTO public.design_documents (id, design_id, snapshot_id, doc_type, rev, doc_no, title, render_payload, content_hash) VALUES ({{doc_x}}, {{design_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 'work_order', 1, 'probe-' || {{doc_x}}::text, 'probe', '{}', 'probe')

INSERT INTO public.orders (id, order_no, design_id, document_id, snapshot_id, contract_amount, company_id, customer_name) VALUES ({{order_x}}, 'probe-' || {{order_x}}::text, {{design_x}}, {{doc_x}}, {{snap_x}}, 0, {{company_x}}, '고객A')

INSERT INTO public.order_reports (id, company_id, order_id, kind, note, photos, reported_by) VALUES ({{rep_a}}, {{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, 'install_done', '설치 끝', '["x/o/a.jpg"]'::jsonb, {{x_owner_user}})

checks.name: 읽기 — 그 팩토리 구성원만 (남의 팩토리 0 · 익명 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.order_reports where order_id = {{order_x}}

checks.name: 구성원은 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.order_reports (company_id, order_id, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, 'as_done')

checks.name: 서버 — A/S 완료 보고 (사진 없이도)
checks.sql: insert into public.order_reports (company_id, order_id, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, 'as_done')

checks.name: 종류는 둘만
checks.sql: insert into public.order_reports (company_id, order_id, kind) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, 'inspect')

checks.name: 사진 10장까지
checks.sql: insert into public.order_reports (company_id, order_id, kind, photos) values ({{company_x}}, {{order_x}}, 'install_done', (select jsonb_agg('p' || g) from generate_series(1, 11) g))

checks.name: 같은 팩토리 수주만 (남의 팩토리 id 로는 거절)
checks.sql: insert into public.order_reports (company_id, order_id, kind) values ({{company_y}}, {{order_x}}, 'install_done')

checks.name: 고치기 · 지우기는 서버도 못 한다
checks.sql: update public.order_reports set note = '바꿈' where id = {{rep_a}}

checks.name: 사진 버킷 — 비공개 · 5MB · JPEG · PNG
checks.sql: select public || '/' || file_size_limit || '/' || array_to_string(allowed_mime_types, ',') from storage.buckets where id = 'order-report-photos'
